name: Divyanshi Verma
tagline: A personal site shaped like an open notebook.
what: The personal site of Divyanshi Verma, collecting marketing and design projects and blog posts. It is for people who want to see her work and writing.
points: The whole site is an open paper notebook with a vine as the spine, a taped photo, a red ribbon bookmark and coloured side tabs for Marketing, Design, Blog and About.
The home page doubles as a numbered index table with project counts and "go to section" links.
Fraunces for the headings, Work Sans for body text, and a handwritten script in the footer, on an off-white (#FAFAFA) dotted page.
A day, night and whimsy switch in the header changes the whole theme.
Small hand-drawn doodles (flask, cloud, moon) sit around the book.
